$ stock count bolts
bolts: 12 in main
[exit 0]

$ stock --format json count bolts
{
  "item": "bolts",
  "warehouse": "main",
  "count": 12
}
[exit 0]

$ stock count --help
Usage: stock count [options] ITEM

Count an item in a warehouse.

Arguments:
      ITEM  Item to count.

Options:
  -w, --warehouse string  Warehouse of the item.  default "main", env STOCK_COUNT_WAREHOUSE

Global options:
      --flag-debug        Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env STOCK_FLAG_DEBUG
      --format text|json  Output format.                                                          default "text", env STOCK_FORMAT
  -h, --help              Show the help.
[exit 0]

$ stock count
stock: count: missing argument ITEM
[exit 2]

$ stock --format json count
{
  "app": "stock",
  "command": "count",
  "message": "missing argument ITEM",
  "usage": true
}
[exit 2]

$ stock --format json cuont bolts
{
  "app": "stock",
  "message": "unknown command \"cuont\"",
  "suggestion": "count",
  "usage": true
}
[exit 2]

# The variable selects the format of a run whose command line fails.
$ STOCK_FORMAT=json stock count bolts --bogus
{
  "app": "stock",
  "command": "count",
  "message": "unknown flag --bogus",
  "usage": true
}
[exit 2]

# A flag after the first fault does not count.
$ stock count bolts --bogus --format json
stock: count: unknown flag --bogus
[exit 2]

$ stock --format json count bolts -w east --flag-debug
[
  {
    "option": "--format",
    "value": "\"json\"",
    "source": "flag --format"
  },
  {
    "option": "--warehouse",
    "value": "\"east\"",
    "source": "flag --warehouse"
  },
  {
    "option": "ITEM",
    "value": "\"bolts\"",
    "source": "argument ITEM"
  }
]
{
  "item": "bolts",
  "warehouse": "east",
  "count": 12
}
[exit 0]
